method: Viewed all 77 contact sheets (4 views x 8 phases; 16 for kb-getup) and enlarged native 480x480 frames for push-up hands, wall push-up, goblet squat, kb-curl, kb-halo, kb-getup sweep, back-lifts/superman feet. Measured every clip's frames[].j with scripts: segment-length variation, knee-hinge axis vs foot transverse axis, shin-foot (ankle) angle, elbow/knee interior angles, trunk twist, floor penetration using drawn radii from figure.ts (hip 70, knee 54, elbow 34 mm; shoe sole at heel/toe joints; flat palm centred on wrist height), foot/hand contact drift, grip-point vs wrist/palm and bar centreline, capsule self-collision (arms vs torso/legs/head, leg vs leg), bell clearance, prop penetration (slabs/tubes), and single-frame joint pops (second difference). Used geometry.json and clip validator for collisions/ZMP. Not observed: real-time playback (timing judged from duration and per-sample joint steps only); the shirt hull was approximated as a capsule; ZMP was not recomputed independently.

kb-swing.summary: Credible hinge swing: knees 143 deg min, hips 86 deg flexion, two-hand grip exactly on the handle in every frame, bell passes between thighs with 5 mm clearance. Forearms brush the inner thighs (-16 mm) on the hike, which is normal contact.

kb-deadlift.summary: Hinge with neutral spine, bell base touches the floor (3 mm) at the bottom and grips stay on the handle. Upper arms press 16 mm into the thighs at the bottom; reads as contact, not impossible.

goblet-squat.summary: Horn grip held at the chest through a 69 deg knee / 108 deg hip squat; heels planted, knees track the toes. Forearms overlap the bell body by up to 14 mm (drawn radii), a small visual merge.

defects.issue: Bell body intersects both forearms by ~14 mm (drawn radii).
defects.fix: Move the bell centre 15 mm forward of the chest or spread the horn grip slightly.

kb-reverse-lunge.summary: Clean alternating lunge with constant segments and goblet hold. The stepping foot skims 4-11 mm above the floor while moving 15-18 mm per sample at lift-off and touch-down (phases 0.07-0.17, 0.45, mirrored), reading as a slight drag.

defects.issue: Stepping foot moves horizontally while still within 11 mm of the floor (drag rather than lift).
defects.fix: Lift the swing foot to >=25 mm clearance before translating it; translate only after lift-off.

defects.issue: Bell overlaps forearms by ~15 mm.
defects.fix: Same bell/forearm offset as goblet squat.

kb-side-lunge.summary: Lateral lunge with 54 deg hip abduction, knee over toes, trailing leg straight, feet planted. Bell/forearm overlap of 18 mm is the only geometric blemish.

defects.issue: Bell intersects forearms ~18 mm.
defects.fix: Offset bell centre forward ~20 mm.

kb-upright-row.summary: Elbows rise to shoulder height with the handle held two-handed; bell grazes the torso hull (-5 mm) at the top, otherwise clear. Wrist sits 75 mm below the handle so the palm stretches slightly but stays attached.

kb-bent-row.summary: Staggered-stance one-arm row: grip on handle every frame, free hand rests on the front thigh (0 mm contact), hips hinge 94 deg, feet planted. Resting hand is a relaxed mitten, not a palm-on-thigh pose (cosmetic).

kb-side-bend.summary: Lateral bend with bell at the side and other hand on the hip; segments constant. The trunk is a single rigid pelvis-chest segment, so the bend pivots at the hips rather than curving through the spine; acceptable for this rig.

kb-curl.summary: Elbow flexes to 48 deg with upper arm fixed at the side; two-hand handle grip constant; bell clears thighs (2 mm) at the bottom.

kb-halo.summary: Bell held upside-down by the horns circles the head; grips stay on the horns, bell keeps 49 mm from the head and 11 mm from the forearms. Biacromial width varies 27 mm (scapular protraction/retraction), plausible. Bell orbits at neck/shoulder height on the sides, so the near forearm crosses the chin at 0.125/0.625.

kb-clean.summary: Hike, hip drive and rack are anatomically consistent; bell lands on the back of the forearm with 6 mm clearance; feet planted. Rack elbow interior angle 26 deg is at the edge of the soft-tissue limit.

kb-press.summary: Rack to lockout press with constant segments, bell resting on forearm (6 mm). Rack elbow interior angle 22 deg is tighter than real soft-tissue contact allows (~30-35 deg), so forearm and upper-arm tubes overlap in the rack.

defects.issue: Rack elbow folded to 22 deg; forearm and upper-arm tubes visibly merge.
defects.fix: Open the rack elbow to ~32 deg (wrist slightly forward of the shoulder).

kb-snatch.summary: Swing-to-overhead path with correct hinge, punch-through and lockout; bell clears head by 165 mm and rests on forearm overhead (4 mm). Fast elbow travel (139 mm/sample) occurs only in the ballistic phase.

kb-getup.summary: Most of the 34 s sequence is credible, but both leg-sweep transitions are geometrically wrong: with the right knee on the floor, the right shin folds up into the air (ankle 431 mm high, above the hip at 389 mm), the knee hinge is twisted ~135 deg relative to the foot (ankle/tibia rotation impossible), the ankle is dorsiflexed to a 20 deg shin-foot angle, and the folded shin passes 65 mm into the pelvis/torso. The right toe also drags 900 mm along the floor across the sweep.

defects.issue: Kneeling leg: shin flips upward behind the body, foot points upward, knee hinge rotated ~135 deg against the foot; shin intersects the torso by 65 mm.
defects.fix: Author the sweep as: shin slides back along the floor (ankle y<=90 mm, instep down) with the foot following tibial rotation; keep knee hinge axis within 30 deg of the foot's transverse axis.

defects.issue: Shin-foot angle 20 deg (extreme dorsiflexion).
defects.fix: Clamp ankle to shin-foot angle >= 70 deg (or >= 160 deg plantarflexed when the instep is on the floor).

defects.issue: Right toe drags ~0.9 m while within 12 mm of the floor.
defects.fix: Pin the toe during kneel-down and lift it before repositioning.

kb-pullover.summary: Standing overhead pullover with two-hand grip; bell clears head by 47 mm and shoulders flex fully without elbow collapse.

alt-arm-leg-plank.summary: Opposite arm and leg lift from a high plank with constant segments, but the trunk never shifts toward the support diagonal: validator ZMP is 0.144 m outside the two-point support, so the pose would topple.

defects.issue: No lateral weight shift onto the supporting hand/foot diagonal; ZMP 0.144 m outside support.
defects.fix: Shift pelvis and chest 60-90 mm toward the support diagonal and add slight trunk rotation before lifting.

defects.issue: Flat (hs=2) hands are exported with the wrist 50 mm above the floor; the palm box is centred on wrist height, so the palm underside floats about 35 mm (20 mm counting the outline) above the floor.
defects.fix: Export floor-hand wrists at about 15-19 mm (palm half-thickness), or have hand-model.ts drop the palm onto y=0 when state===2.

back-lifts.summary: Prone back extension with a geometric impossibility for the whole clip: both feet are folded forward onto the shins (shin-foot angle 2 deg, toes pointing toward the knees, soles up). The body also floats: knees and hips 100 mm high with drawn radii 54-70 mm, so legs hover 30-46 mm over the floor.

defects.issue: Feet folded onto the shins (2 deg shin-foot angle) instead of plantarflexed behind.
defects.fix: Place toe joints beyond the ankle along the shin line (shin-foot ~160-175 deg) with toes resting on the floor and heels up.

defects.issue: Thighs and pelvis float 30-46 mm above the floor.
defects.fix: Lower prone hip/knee joints to their drawn radius (~55-70 mm) so the body rests on the floor.

band-pull.summary: Arm path and grips are fine, but the band is a straight rigid tube between the hands; at full abduction it runs through both upper arms (-35 mm).

defects.issue: Band passes through the upper arms at the T position.
defects.fix: Route the band in front of the chest (sag/offset forward 60-80 mm) or stop horizontal abduction ~10 deg short of the arm line.

behind-back-clasp.summary: Hands clasp behind the back (overlap is the clasp) and lift without elbow or shoulder impossibility; feet planted.

defects.issue: ZMP 0.107 m outside the buttock contact patch.
defects.fix: Keep the shoulders lower (shoulder blades just off the floor) or move pelvis to put COM over the sacrum.

defects.issue: Arm snaps down in ~3 samples.
defects.fix: Ease the release over >=10 samples.

wall-pushup.summary: Wall push-up uses the floor hand state, so the palms stay horizontal (normal forced down) instead of flat on the wall; the mittens poke straight through the 40 mm wall and are visible on its far side from the front view.

defects.issue: Hands horizontal and penetrating the wall slab.
defects.fix: Add a wall-contact hand state (palm normal = wall normal, fingers up) or orient state-2 palms to the nearest support surface.

wide-pushup.summary: Wide push-up with elbows ~35 deg from the trunk, rigid plank.

defects.issue: Flat (hs=2) hands are exported with the wrist 50 mm above the floor; the palm box is centred on wrist height, so the palm underside floats about 35 mm (20 mm counting the outline) above the floor.
defects.fix: Export floor-hand wrists at about 15-19 mm (palm half-thickness), or have hand-model.ts drop the palm onto y=0 when state===2.
